title: Detailed watermelon slice
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='rindG' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3fae4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2c7d36'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='fleshG' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0243f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow of slice -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='88' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#7a2f3a' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- outer rind (dark green) -->
  <path d='M14 52 A36 36 0 0 0 86 52 Z' fill='url(#rindG)'/>
  <!-- pale green inner rind -->
  <path d='M19 52 A31 31 0 0 0 81 52 Z' fill='#c8f0a8'/>
  <!-- red flesh -->
  <path d='M23 52 A27 27 0 0 0 77 52 Z' fill='url(#fleshG)'/>
  <!-- highlight on flesh -->
  <path d='M30 52 A20 20 0 0 0 44 50 L44 52 Z' fill='#ff8f9c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- seeds -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='66' rx='2.6' ry='3.6' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(-20 42 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='70' rx='2.6' ry='3.6' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(15 56 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='60' rx='2.4' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(20 63 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='57' rx='2.2' ry='3.2' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(-25 36 57)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='77' rx='2.4' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(-5 48 77)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='70' rx='2.2' ry='3.2' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(30 67 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='63' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#3a1230' transform='rotate(-30 29 63)'/>
  <!-- seed gloss dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='64.5' r='0.9' fill='#f2c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='68.5' r='0.9' fill='#f2c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='58.5' r='0.8' fill='#f2c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='75.5' r='0.8' fill='#f2c8d8'/>
</svg>
